question: Conditional on a route-new species being acoustically recruited in the wet survey, is its strong chorus activity preferentially placed at physical SiteIDs where that same species had formed a strong chorus in years before the focal pair?
population: Physically stable matched pairs with at least one prior eligible run in the same State x RouteNumber x RunNumber stratum.
focal_species: Species absent from all ten dry-run stops, present at >=1 wet-run stop, and recorded somewhere on the same route-season stratum in at least one year strictly before the earlier year of the focal pair.
unit: pair x focal species x physical stop.

predictors.prior_site_strong: 1 if the focal species had CallingIndex 2 or 3 at this same SiteID in any prior eligible run; 0 otherwise.
predictors.prior_site_any: 1 if the focal species had any CallingIndex >0 at this same SiteID in any prior eligible run; sensitivity.
predictors.prior_route_frequency: Fraction of prior eligible runs in which the species occurred anywhere on the route; used only as a descriptive species-history covariate and constant within species-pair.

outcomes.wet_strong: 1 if wet CallingIndex at the stop is 2 or 3.
outcomes.wet_presence: 1 if wet CallingIndex >0, secondary placement endpoint.

primary_design: Restrict to pair x species groups having both prior_site_strong=1 and 0 among their ten stops. Demean wet_strong and prior_site_strong within pair x species, then OLS without intercept; cluster covariance by State x RouteNumber.
primary_prediction: Coefficient on within-species-pair prior_site_strong >0 with complete 95% CI >0.
secondary: Report but do not gate rain_contrast * prior_site_strong after pair-species demeaning; positive interaction would mean stronger rainfall contrasts sharpen local memory targeting.
minimum_gate: At least 500 informative pair x species groups, >=250 routes, and >=20 species.
interpretation: Support identifies site-specific recurrence of acoustic activity after controlling exactly for species and focal pair.
It does not prove continuous occupancy, individual philopatry, causal memory, or that the same individuals returned.
Because focal species are conditioned to be route-new in the wet survey, the test concerns spatial placement of reactivation, not whether the species activates at all.
